responsibility: Provides IA-64 machine-description support for inline division and square-root style floating-point operations that are built from predicated RFmode helper instructions rather than a single hardware pattern. It defines conditional add/subtract/multiply/fused-multiply-add instruction forms and expansion sequences for reciprocal- and sqrt-based algorithms, controlling latency-versus-throughput variants, FP status/rounding operands, and conversions between DF/XF and the IA-64 internal RF register format.
